east_catalysts_risks.notes: Thin result. The search tool surfaced almost nothing published inside the window. Not found or verified: the TOI Panathur underpass item (16 Oct), the Asianet Red Line soil-testing item, the Hindu Whitefield senior-living flooding item (thehindu.com blocked), the Indian Express original on the PRR-2 suspension, and the Trade Brains Varthur/Panathur 135% item. The PRR-2 suspension rests on one weak secondary site. The Brigade WTC item rests on one finance blog. No claims reported on office leasing, Cauvery water, STRR, OMR/Hoskote or suburban rail inside the window. Background found but not reported as claims: Red Line geotechnical contracts were reportedly awarded on 13 Feb 2026 (Wikipedia). Revised DPR resubmitted April 2026, central approval expected around October 2026, civil work targeted May 2027, completion April 2033 (search-summary only, DH pages returned 403). K-RIDE reported in June 2026 that suburban rail services begin Dec 2028 (Asianet, search snippet only). Extended-mode searches were partly cut off.

east_launches_prices.notes:
Thin window. The only in-window launch-type item found is Brigade's Whitefield WTC, and it rests on a trade publication. I found no Brigade press release, RERA number or price. Search results otherwise gave listing and pre-launch pages with no dates in the window, so I excluded them. Pre-launch leads seen only in aggregator results (not reported, unverified): Godrej ~20-acre Whitefield parcel, Prestige 21-acre Whitefield, Sumadhura Kannamangala JDA, Puravankara Sarjapur JDA.

The Trade Brains Varthur/Panathur article of 14 Oct reports C&W figures: Varthur avg Rs 13,050/sqft and Panathur avg Rs 15,300/sqft, with five-year appreciation of 135.10% and 128.40%. I did not record these as claims because I could not obtain verbatim excerpts for them. Search snippets suggest the article's other numbers conflict with a second Trade Brains piece, so check them against the report.

Not verified: the Times of India Panathur underpass item (16 Oct) and the Asianet Red Line soil-testing item (16 Oct). Searches by headline returned only older items, and the Hindu Whitefield senior-living piece was blocked. Search snippets suggest Red Line geotechnical contracts were awarded in Feb 2026, but I could not fetch the source (Deccan Herald returned 403).

Only 5 of the 6 minimum fetches succeeded and I did not reach developer sites or the RERA portal. A further pass on those is advisable.

north_south_west.notes: The evidence for this task is thin. Only the Puravankara Sathanur JDA (12 Oct 2026) was confirmed from fetched text. It is also syndicated company press-release text, so I tagged it as developer-sourced; both copies are the same release, not independent reporting. Deccan Herald, The Hindu and TheRealtyToday were blocked (403 or fetch refusal). Hospitalitynet and Angel One timed out. Several searches were cut off. I found no original text for these leads: BMRCL Red Line soil testing (Asianet), the Bommasandra-Hosur and other-routes comparison (Trade Brains), Bannerghatta Road junction upgrades (NIE, NewsFirst), Chandapura traffic jam, Jakkur-Amruthahalli closure, Air India Sats warehousing, and the Kalyani/Hilton signing. A search summary dates the Hilton signing to 6 Oct 2026, before the window, so I left it out. I did not report anything I could not quote. Swan Realty's Bodhi in Jayanagar is central Bengaluru, outside this task's focus. Search summaries say the Bommasandra-Hosur link is still unsettled: BMRCL reportedly rejected it earlier in 2026, and Tamil Nadu said in August 2026 that it is still pursuing it. Those summaries are unverified, and I have no quotable page. I found no villa or plotted-development launches dated in the window for Devanahalli, Doddaballapur, Hoskote, Kanakapura Road, Bidadi, Electronic City, Hosur Road, Mysore Road, Kengeri or Tumkur Road. I did not reach the stronger sources, so a re-run with different fetch routes is advisable for the Red Line soil-testing and Bannerghatta Road items.

social_signals.notes: No in-window (14–17 Oct 2026) social content found. Reddit (www and old) was blocked to the fetch tool. LinkedIn required login. YouTube search returned no listings. 11 web searches, including site: queries for reddit, youtube and economictimes, returned no Reddit, YouTube or LinkedIn posts and nothing dated in the window. They returned only developer and portal marketing blogs (Sobha, Godrej, NBR, Sattva, Brigade) and older news. These sources are undated or pre-window, and are interested-party material, so no claims were recorded. Background seen but not recorded: Arvind SmartSpaces Nagondanahalli (Whitefield) launch, askfuzz.ai, 10 Mar 2026. Shriram Properties' 4-acre Sarjapur Main Road purchase (Feb 2026), with launch expected late 2026, was seen only in search-result summaries and not verified by fetch. Cushman & Wakefield Q1 2026: East Bengaluru 57% of launches, per propnewz secondhand. A rerun is needed with a tool that can reach Reddit or YouTube.
